hero.title: Be a part of our team.
hero.subtitle: We are so glad you want to join us in exploring a world of endless opportunities at Mera Driver. Let’s find a spot for you.

perks.text: We pride ourselves on rewarding great work with great compensation.
Flexible hours and vacation. Night owls welcome.
Meet new cultures and enjoy our crew from all over the world.

items.name: Pritha Mistry
items.quote: Mera Driver, for me holds a special place. I was skeptical before joining. But after I joined, the experience speaks for itself. Hardworking and goal oriented team as well as Manager.

items.name: Bhavana Rathi
items.quote: Mera Driver has been Home for me. Pleasant multicultural environment and the enthusiasm which everyone around carries is infectious. Proud to be a part of Mera Driver.

items.name: Ankit Prajapati
items.quote: Solving mobility challenges for millions of riders every day gives immense satisfaction. The freedom to innovate and build scalable tech at Mera Driver is unmatched.
